posts.cooked:
@22f3000671 @21f3000759 @AtulPS @sayan

Dear Sir,

I was tring to connect to se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in via ssh but the it is not connecting.

The ssh keys are properly set and are there.

dhruv@BANSALVICTUS:~$ ls .ssh/
config  github_key  github_key.pub  id_ed25519  id_ed25519.pub  known_hosts  known_hosts.old
dhruv@BANSALVICTUS:~$

When I do connect I get -

dhruv@BANSALVICTUS:~$ ssh -v 24f1001707@se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in
OpenSSH_9.6p1 Ubuntu-3ubuntu13.14, OpenSSL 3.0.13 30 Jan 2024
debug1: Reading configuration data /home/dhruv/.ssh/config
debug1: Reading configuration data /etc/ssh/ssh_config
debug1: /etc/ssh/ssh_config line 19: include /etc/ssh/ssh_config.d/*.conf matched no files
debug1: /etc/ssh/ssh_config line 21: Applying options for *
debug1: Connecting to se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in [194.195.113.53] port 22.

I tried to ping and it is successfull -

dhruv@BANSALVICTUS:~$ ping -c 5 se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in
PING se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in (194.195.113.53) 56(84) bytes of data.
64 bytes from 194-195-113-53.ip.linodeusercontent.com (194.195.113.53): icmp_seq=1 ttl=50 time=29.3 ms
64 bytes from 194-195-113-53.ip.linodeusercontent.com (194.195.113.53): icmp_seq=2 ttl=50 time=30.2 ms
64 bytes from 194-195-113-53.ip.linodeusercontent.com (194.195.113.53): icmp_seq=3 ttl=50 time=28.3 ms
64 bytes from 194-195-113-53.ip.linodeusercontent.com (194.195.113.53): icmp_seq=4 ttl=50 time=35.9 ms
64 bytes from 194-195-113-53.ip.linodeusercontent.com (194.195.113.53): icmp_seq=5 ttl=50 time=37.5 ms

--- se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in ping statistics ---
5 packets transmitted, 5 received, 0% packet loss, time 4353ms
rtt min/avg/max/mdev = 28.282/32.216/37.517/3.741 ms

I tried to check it my network or ssh not working via testing ssh github and it says ok

dhruv@BANSALVICTUS:~$ ssh git@github.com
PTY allocation request failed on channel 0
Hi dhruvbansalup! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.
Connection to ssh.github.com closed.

Please guide me, how to resolve this issue.

Thankyou

What’s the problem here? You’re using the verbose flag -v so this is expected behavior. Can you tell what happens when you don’t use the -v flag. Maybe also include the full log of the output when using this flag.

Common reasons for not being able to log into the VM is uploading incorrect keys at the VM website. Maybe check first whether you have uploaded the keys properly or not.

posts.name: Dhruv Bansal
posts.cooked:
@22f2001554

Dear Sir,

I’ve been using ssh -v to check logs. The output shows:

image701×155 2.23 KB

and then it just hangs. It doesn’t proceed further.

I suspect my IP is blocked or port 22 is being filtered by IITM server, because when I tested

PS C:\Users\dhruv> Test-NetConnection se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in -Port 22
WARNING: TCP connect to (194.195.113.53 : 22) failed


ComputerName           : se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in
RemoteAddress          : 194.195.113.53
RemotePort             : 22
InterfaceAlias         : Wi-Fi
SourceAddress          : 192.168.1.13
PingSucceeded          : True
PingReplyDetails (RTT) : 33 ms
TcpTestSucceeded       : False

So the server responds to ping, but TCP connections on port 22 fail.

Please Guide how to resolve

posts.cooked: I have editted your post and tagged @AtulPS sir and @sayan sir. They might be able to help in this.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
Can you try changing network maybe switching to mobile network & try?

Since it stops at Port 22 so it means → Port 22 is blocked by your network or server firewall.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: Looks like a user side network issue, try with other network as rceommended by Swati

posts.name: Dhruv Bansal
posts.cooked: I am now able to connect to VM using VPN Only. Without VPN it is not connecting.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: It’s likely a local network issue - your ISP, router firewall, or port 22 being blocked, which is why it works over VPN but not on your normal connection.

posts.name: Dhruv Bansal
posts.cooked:
I have checked my router’s firewall it is not blocking anything. It may me the ISP.

Is there any way to unblock the port 22 from the ISP. Or it is not feasible.

Thankyou
